description: A link the person taps to join the place's line from their phone, optionally with a service and team member filled in. You cannot join for them: they confirm on the place's own page. Use it for walking in now; for a set time later, use booking_link. If the place isn't taking check-ins right now, or that service or team member isn't available there, it says so instead of returning a link.

memberId.description: Optional team member id from get_place
